meta.name: Little Stars Universe: Barney & Friends
meta.description:
Welcome to Little Stars Universe, your little ones 24/7 preschool destination. Learn, play, go on fun epic adventures and make new friends. There is always something different and exciting to watch on Little Stars Universe!

Shows: Barney & Friends, Maggie and the Ferocious Beast, The wubbulous world of Dr. Seuss, Miss Spider's Sunny Patch Friends, The Cat In The Hat Knows A Lot About...
Available on: Pluto TV
